cover.headline:
Stop using the ab wheel
[y]like this.[/y]

image.placeholder: Side-on, camera at mat height, Dan on his knees rolling out and letting his hips sag to the mat at the bottom, lower back arched (the mistake), 3 slow reps
Side-on, same setup: Dan at full roll-out with hips sagged and lower back visibly arched, hold 2 seconds at the bottom

mistake.headline:
Hips sag
at the bottom.
mistake.body: The biggest ab wheel mistake. Letting your hips sag arches your lower back, and that's how guys get hurt.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan rolling out on the ab wheel from his knees, body straight from head to knees

fix.headline:
Straight line,
head to knees.
fix.body: Start on your knees, wheel under your shoulders. Roll out slow, only as far as you can with control. [em]Pull back with your abs, not your arms.[/em]

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan kneeling with the ab wheel by the pool

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for the ab wheel
items: Only roll out as far as you can with control.
Roll out a little further every week.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy whose ab wheel reps end face down on the mat.

cta.follow: One fix a week, filmed on me.
